explanations.6: The `show=False` parameter tells the diagram library not to automatically open the generated image file when done.
explanations.15: The minus operator (`-`) here creates a visual connection line between these three components in the diagram.
explanations.16: The `>>` operator creates a directional arrow from left to right, showing data or traffic flow between components.
explanations.18: The `<<` operator creates a directional arrow pointing backward (right to left), showing that the storage class and persistent volume connect back to support all the apps we created in the loop.
